description: Search doctors listed on Dr. AI Hub (draihub.com) by specialty and/or city in Egypt. Returns name, specialty, city, clinic, address, fee in EGP, clinic hours, rating and the profile URL where a patient books for free. Arabic or English words both work (e.g. "dentist", "طب الأسنان", "Sohag", "سوهاج").

city.description: City in Egypt, e.g. "Cairo", "Girga", "سوهاج". See list_cities.

limit.description: How many doctors to return (default 10, max 25).

name.description: Part of the doctor or clinic name.

name: search_doctors
title: Find doctors in Egypt
